label: The seam is where phase 2 recorded it: ordered is built at :233, truncated derives from ordered.length at :238 and the capped slice is assigned at :239, so a total-count field needs three declarations (JSDoc :148-159, answer literal :168-179, assignment at :238) and no new computation.

Field name and placement: totalCandidates, alphabetically between tokens (:177) and truncated (:178), initialized to 0 in the literal because the tokenless early return at :182 bypasses ranking; it counts documents after the scope and scoring filters and before the cap, deduplicated by the byPath Map at :210-224.

Human output: add of totalCandidates only inside the truncated branch at :332, yielding candidates : 20 of 137 (truncated) from 42 phrase(s) and leaving every untruncated line byte-identical to today.

Compatibility surface is five consumers that read named fields, never a closed shape: trigger-index.vitest.ts asserts candidatePhraseCount (:854) and truncated (:935) and parses JSON in runLookup (:910-915); host-trigger-index.vitest.ts asserts only the human source line (:183-184); measure-cold-lookup.mjs reads results.length (:99); workflow.ts (:293) and generate-trigger-index.mjs (:542) import loadIndex only; the doctor asset records candidatePhraseCount (:176) without parsing. No shell, jq or hook consumer of the answer exists.

The section 9 row must mirror isExcludedResearchPath exactly: first research segment at index >= 3 under specs, numbered parent matching /^\d{3}-/, everything below pruned except a single research.md child (:168-174). The parity suite asserts the behavior (:139-163) but SCOPED_DIVERGENCES registers only lineages and fixtures (:82-101), so the broader research divergence needs a third entry to honor the suite header at :26-30.
The answer object stays alphabetically ordered and totalCandidates is initialized to 0, so the tokenless early return still emits the key instead of dropping it from JSON.
Exit status remains a function of returned row scores only: 0 for any score above zero, 1 for a scoring-only miss, 2 for invocation or index failure; totalCandidates never changes it.
